bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/menu-idempotent-8dc8d56-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8dc8d5638e7711688be549acf1127ea5bc09b1c1 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:idem-8dc8d56)" || exit 62
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
query="SELECT count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile' AND message_id>0 AND message_thread_id>0"
count="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "$query" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test "$count" = 1 || { echo TARGET_PANEL_NOT_IN_EXPECTED_STATE; exit 63; }
mid="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT message_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile'" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test -n "$mid" || exit 64
changed="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "UPDATE board_menu_panels SET state='verified',updated_at=NOW() WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile' AND message_id=$mid RETURNING panel_id" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[a-f0-9-]{20,}$' | head -n1)"
test -n "$changed" || exit 65
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-gay-idem-update.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" run --rm --no-deps -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e MENU_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID=-1003770334893 gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >"$log" 2>&1;then
 echo TARGET_PUBLISH_FAILED
 if grep -qi 'message is not modified' "$log";then echo TELEGRAM_EDIT_CLASS=NOT_MODIFIED;elif grep -qi 'message to edit not found' "$log";then echo TELEGRAM_EDIT_CLASS=NOT_FOUND;elif grep -qi "message can't be edited" "$log";then echo TELEGRAM_EDIT_CLASS=UNEDITABLE;else echo TELEGRAM_EDIT_CLASS=OTHER_OR_UNKNOWN;fi
 exit 66
fi
python3 - "$log" "$mid" <<'PY'
import json,sys
got=[]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
 try: row=json.loads(line)
 except (ValueError,TypeError):continue
 if row.get("panel_type")=="posting":got.append(row)
assert len(got)==1 and int(got[0]["chat_id"])==-1003770334893
assert int(got[0]["message_id"])==int(sys.argv[2]) and got[0]["updated_existing"] is True
print("GAY_POSTING_EXISTING_MESSAGE_UPDATED=PASS")
PY
final="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND message_id=$mid" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test "$final" = 1 || exit 67
echo GAY_POSTING_EXISTING_IN_PLACE=PASS
